name: a-street-of-landmarks
title: A street of landmarks
summary: Four landmarks on one street, each at its real size and facing it: the Duomo di Milano, the Sainte-Chapelle and the Sagrada Família on the north side, Neuschwanstein across from them. Their real sites are far apart; this street is a what-if. Every building keeps its own parts, sources and joints.

name: kestrel-at-saturn
title: KESTREL at Saturn
summary: KESTREL, an invented ring-ice pusher, at work by Saturn's rings, the planet huge behind it at its real size from about 350,000 km. Each construct keeps its own parts, sources and joints.

name: rain-harbour
title: Rain Harbour, a night street
summary: A game level from a concept picture: 60 m of a rain-soaked night street in an invented harbour district, its towers, bilingual neon signs (real English and Chinese that mean what they say) and one drivable hero car. 21 constructs placed 50 times, each made in masterpiece rounds; then the world itself ran 12 rounds against the picture. Designed, not surveyed.

name: stortorget
title: Stortorget at Christmas
summary: Stockholm's old square at its Christmas market, December 2022, from one photograph (Ximonic / Simo Räsänen, CC BY-SA 4.0, not included): eight houses researched one by one, the red No. 20 and the orange No. 18 among them, one market stall placed 41 times, the spruce, the lamp and the granite block. Heights and the stalls' layout are inferred, not surveyed. No people or vehicles.

name: the-shed
title: The shed and the things around it
summary: A garden shed with its planned deck and log store, a 1960s VW T1 Samba parked by the log store, a Vespa GS 150 on its stand by the door, State Bench set up inside on the floor, and Rietveld's Red-Blue Chair inside by the door. Five constructs, each whole, at real size.

name: villa-savoye-lived-in
title: The Villa Savoye, lived in
summary: The Villa Savoye (Poissy, 1931) with a life moved in: an Eames lounge chair and two tables in the salon, a Braun SK 4, a Revox A77 and a Leica M3 on one, SERUM 2 / 61 on the other, a Tompion year-going clock against the wall and a Jackson by the studio table; a Land Cruiser and an Aston Martin DB5 under the pilotis, where the ground floor follows a car's turning circle; and KESTREL, far off over the roof. Every construct keeps its own parts, sources and joints.
